description: This Java test class verifies the functionality and immutability of the FeaturesModified class related to features modification events in the Eclipse Ditto framework. It focuses on testing JSON serialization/deserialization, equality, and handling null inputs.

classes.name: FeaturesModifiedTest
classes.description: Unit test class for FeaturesModified, verifying immutability, equality, JSON serialization/deserialization, and null handling.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Verifies that the FeaturesModified class and its Features dependency are immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Checks that equals and hashCode are properly implemented for FeaturesModified.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullThingIdString
methods.description: Tests that creating FeaturesModified with null ThingId string throws ThingIdInvalidException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullThingId
methods.description: Tests that creating FeaturesModified with null ThingId throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullFeatures
methods.description: Tests that creating FeaturesModified with null features throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: toJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies that toJson produces the expected JSON output.

methods.name: createInstanceFromValidJson
methods.description: Verifies that a FeaturesModified instance can be created correctly from JSON.
